query_analysis.original_query: What's the impact of feed composition variability on the performance of our crude distillation column?
query_analysis.expanded_query: Analyze the effect of variations in crude oil feed composition on the separation efficiency and product quality of the crude distillation unit.

clarification_questions: What are the typical ranges of variability in the crude oil feed composition?
Which specific performance metrics are of primary concern (e.g., product purity, yield, energy efficiency)?
Are there any historical data or case studies available on similar feed composition variability scenarios?
